entry.title: Spoofing is not stealing: the CVE-2026-104935 authentication problem
entry.summary:
Spoofing is not stealing: the CVE-2026-104935 authentication problem
A distinction that changes the response
Most authentication incidents involve a credential that was supposed to work. A password is reused, a token is stolen, a session is hijacked. CVE-2026-104935 belongs to a different category. Ivanti classifies it as CWE-290, authentication bypass by spoofing, which means the attacker never needed a working credential in the first place. In a spoofing-based bypass the system makes its authentication decision from a value the caller controls or influences. The gateway evaluates the claim, finds it acceptable, and treats the session as authenticated. There is no password to reset and no token to revoke, because no valid authentication material was ever involved. Organizatio…

Free tiers of Large Language Model (LLM) APIs offer a starting point for experimenting with AI capabilities without significant upfront costs. entry.title: Excel custom number format: add units without breaking SUM
entry.summary: Expense sheets and price lists often need a unit after the number: a currency name, "pcs", "kg". The quick way, typing it straight into the cell, has a cost that's easy to miss. The moment a cell contains 25,000원 (25,000 won, Korean currency) as typed text, Excel stops treating it as a number, and SUM silently skips it. In our test sheet, the correct total was 194,500.
